evidence.describe: Trip manifests containing all applicable minimum fields.

requirements.notes: Quoted from official Georgia DCH July 1, 2022 NEMT manual. The effective_from value here denotes the available source version, NOT the original legal effective date; historical application must be reviewed. Georgia MMIS portal lists an October 1, 2026 update; its full text was not independently retrieved, so this obligation must be reconciled before production deployment. In the 2022 manual the listed duty may be imposed on the broker to ensure provider compliance; TripProof monitors the provider/driver/vehicle as the practical qualified subject.
